helloBody: Give me your notes, your slides or just a topic, and I’ll turn it into a course for your exam. Then we study it together.
name: What’s your name?
aiBody: I’ve already looked at what you have on this computer. If unsure, keep the one I marked: you can change it anytime.
platformTitle: Do you use a study platform?
platformBody: Canvas, Moodle, Classroom, Blackboard… Sign in once and Aula brings your dates and materials. Optional.
doneBody: Start with a new course or open the sample to see how it works.
